## One dashboard for every tool you build

Django Control Room adds a hub to Django Admin where your team finds every tool, whether it lives in your project or ships as a package.

### Inside your project

A Django app in your codebase for tools only your team needs. Nothing to publish.

● INTERNAL Listed under Internal Panels

### As a reusable package

Ship it through PyPI, a private index, or a repository, and install it in any project.

● CONNECTED Listed under Community Panels

### Permission scopes

Staff-only by default. Lock a single page or action to a group in settings.

# settings.py DJ_URLS_PANEL_SETTINGS = { "SCOPE_PERMISSIONS" : { "execute" : { "ALLOWED_GROUPS" : [ "platform-admins" ], }, }, }

### Built-in MCP

One endpoint exposes every panel's tools to AI agents, under the same permissions.

// an agent calls your panel's tool { "method" : "tools/call" , "params" : { "name" : "billing_ops__retry_payment" , "arguments" : { "payment_id" : 4812 } } }

### Theme adapters

Panels pick up Unfold, Jazzmin, Grappelli, and other admin themes automatically.
